environment: Python 3.14.7 with -I, git, Node, scratch cwd; branches.py at 6ad4424

cases.title: Uncompilable patterns give unevaluated with the note, negate or not
cases.when: judge is called with the input
cases.actual: held for (, [a-, *, a{2,1}, (?P<, backslash; bad pattern beside a passing rule is unevaluated

cases.title: Pattern nested 900, 5000 and 100000 deep leaves the sample unevaluated (fix of r0)
cases.when: judge is called with the input
cases.then: judge returns unevaluated with a cannot evaluate note
cases.expected: judge returns unevaluated with a cannot evaluate note
cases.actual: unevaluated with note 'cannot evaluate deep: the pattern is nested too deeply' for balanced, open and (?: forms, negate true and false

cases.title: Invalid refs fail with git check-ref-format; valid refs pass
cases.when: judge is called with the input
cases.then: fail with rule git check-ref-format for 19 invalid samples; pass for 2 valid
cases.expected: fail with rule git check-ref-format for 19 invalid samples; pass for 2 valid

cases.title: NUL, surrogate, flag-like, corpus samples and git off PATH give Fail or a verdict; nothing written
cases.when: judge is called with the input
cases.then: no traceback, no option read, no file written
cases.expected: no traceback, no option read, no file written
cases.actual: as expected; git off PATH gives Fail; scratch cwd stays empty

cases.title: A repetition count too large for re leaves the sample unevaluated
cases.when: judge is called with the input
cases.actual: judge raises OverflowError: the repetition number is too large (re.compile rejects the pattern with OverflowError, not re.error); regex_error and evaluate raise too

cases.title: A rule without a label keeps rule null when it fails before the git check
cases.when: judge is called with the input

attacks.input: ( [a- * a{2,1} (?P< \ with negate true and false

attacks.charter: Explore regex rules with deep nesting to find a RecursionError
attacks.input: 900 and 100000 balanced pairs, 5000 open parentheses, 3000 (?: groups
attacks.observed: unevaluated with nested-too-deeply note; the r0 break is fixed

attacks.charter: Explore regex rules with huge repetition counts to find an exception other than re.error
attacks.observed: OverflowError out of judge, regex_error and evaluate

attacks.charter: Explore other pattern forms for exceptions
attacks.input: 1e6 char class, 200000 alternatives, NUL, lone surrogate, bad backref, bad conditional, undefined \N name, bad flag, bad range, look-behind of variable width, nested repeat
attacks.test: manual: true, probe script run with python3 -I

attacks.charter: Explore samples with flag-like and control values to find a git option read or a traceback
Explore the environment with git off PATH

seeds.title: @{-1} and @ pass the ref check
seeds.detail: git check-ref-format --branch expands @{-1} inside a repo and accepts @. Two seed tests fail. Reject a sample that is @ or starts with @{, or run git check-ref-format without --branch.

seeds.title: catastrophic regex blocks judge
seeds.detail: (a+)+$ against a 28 character sample ran 9.9 seconds in r0. The spec accepts this. Send to verify-limits.

seeds.title: non-string sample or pattern raises TypeError
seeds.detail: judge with a null pattern or a non-string sample raises TypeError. Rules come from the forge reader and samples are strings by contract, so this is outside the threat model.
